source: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit 12.8.1 PTX ISA documentation
paraphrase: The PTX contract distinguishes approximate reciprocal from explicitly rounded reciprocal. Its f32 approximate form has a stated maximum error of one ULP; optional FTZ changes subnormal treatment. This specifies a numerical envelope, not a single CPU-reproducible approximation algorithm.
relation_to_original_DLL: The original active executable fatbin had no listed PTX. The SASS sequence is directly observed, but mapping its MUFU.RCP result to this exact PTX numerical contract remains a stated assumption. The offline envelope is conditional and cannot set a conversion pass bit.
